vocabulary.definition: something that is difficult or impossible to understand or explain
vocabulary.example: The disappearance of the ancient civilization remains a mystery to archaeologists.

vocabulary.definition: to form a theory or set of theories about something based on limited evidence
vocabulary.example: Scientists theorize that the universe began with a Big Bang.

vocabulary.definition: a type of particle accelerator that brings charged particles together at high speeds in order to cause collisions
vocabulary.example: The researchers used a collider to study the behavior of subatomic particles.

vocabulary.definition: the curved path that an object follows through space or the air
vocabulary.example: The quarterback calculated the trajectory of the football to throw a successful pass.

vocabulary.definition: to gradually become destroyed or spoiled
vocabulary.example: The old building began to decay due to neglect.

vocabulary.definition: relating to the gathering and analysis of data based on a large quantity of information
vocabulary.example: The researchers conducted a statistical analysis of the survey results.
